value.zh: OP104度为设计光学视场；ME107度计入镜头/支架组装结构。机械视场通常更大以避免光路干涉/图像遮挡；侧视光线标V、底视标H/D/ME；不是实测流视场。
value.en: OP104 degrees is design optical FOV; ME107 degrees includes lens/holder assembly. Mechanical FOV is generally larger to avoid optical interference/image occlusion; diagram rays markV in side view andH/D/ME in bottom view. Not a measured stream FOV.

note.zh: Gemini 305g为面向机器人腕部近距感知的双目彩色相机，采用MX6800 ASIC，支持GMSL2及同步。与USB型305分开建档；V1.0将USB口限定为初期评估/配置，IP65须满足封堵及连接条件。不同官网表的功耗、重量公差、防护、滤光及流格式差异均保留，不宣称已完成整份手册。
note.en: Gemini 305g is a stereo-color camera for close-range robot-wrist sensing, using the MX6800 ASIC with GMSL2 and synchronization. It is distinct from USB-model 305. V1.0 limits USB to initial evaluation/configuration; IP65 requires sealing and connection conditions. Conflicting power, mass tolerance, protection, filtering and stream values remain source-specific; the full manual is not yet transcribed.

The official catalog classifies it as legacy; downloadable documentation does not establish current availability.

note.zh: Localization SDK是用于在PhoXi扫描点云中匹配刚体CAD模型的C++开发库，返回模型相对于扫描坐标系的位姿；随包提供Configurator及PLCF配置工作流。本记录限于1.3版、2020-05手册和2020-05-04发布说明，不代表当前最新版或已实测兼容性。许可方式和配置器不是额外SKU，也不等同于Locator Studio或Photoneo Locator。
note.en: Localization SDK is a C++ library for matching rigid CAD objects in PhoXi scan point clouds and returning model poses in scan coordinates. Its package includes Configurator and the PLCF configuration workflow. This record covers version1.3, the May2020 manual and May4,2020 release article, not the current latest version or locally tested compatibility. License methods and Configurator are not additional SKUs; Locator Studio and Photoneo Locator remain separate products.

note.en: The explicitly distinguished Instant Library is also called PhoXi Instant Meshing in its product description. Its UI and C++ library integrate MotionCam-3D point-cloud streams into triangular meshes, estimate camera movement from 3D features and align data automatically, with camera-position input also supported. Handheld, robot-arm and multi-camera arrangements are not separate software SKUs. Coverage is limited to the comparison and corresponding descriptions checked October18,2026; latency, frame rate, release number and ambiguous PC-configuration ownership are not inferred.

conditions.en: MID-360 User Manual v1.2 (2024.04), PDF7-13 only; no MID-360S, Avia or HAP inheritance. No serial-plus-suffix broadcast-number formula inferred.

bota-systems.zh: Bota Systems AG 于 2020 年成立，总部位于苏黎世，官网将其描述为苏黎世联邦理工学院衍生公司。其公开业务集中在六维力/力矩传感器、机器人集成套件和配件。
bota-systems.en: Bota Systems AG was founded in 2020, is headquartered in Zurich, and describes itself as an ETH Zurich spin-off. Its public business centers on six-axis force/torque sensors, robot integration kits, and accessories.

bota-systems.zh: 本仓按当前官方产品页拆分量程变体，避免把同一外壳下的 T5、T15、T25、T60、T80、T180 和 T540 当作同一数值产品。厂商说明过载值来自有限元模拟，实物可能偏离，因此不能把过载值当作工作量程。
bota-systems.en: The repository separates current range variants so T5, T15, T25, T60, T80, T180, and T540 variants sharing a housing are not treated as one numeric product. The manufacturer states that overload figures are FEA simulations and may differ in practice, so overload limits must not be treated as operating ranges.

bota-systems.zh: 官网在线门户公开价格只适用于页面所示数量、地区和时间，不在本仓作为固定采购价格。公司未提供面向公众的定期财务报告库，本档案不据此推断收入、利润或客户集中度。
bota-systems.en: Online-store prices apply only to the displayed quantity, region, and time and are not stored as fixed procurement prices. The company does not expose a public periodic-financial-report library; this profile does not infer revenue, profit, or customer concentration.

robotous.zh: ROBOTOUS 的 RFT 系列采用电容式六维力/力矩测量，目录包含紧凑、中空、防尘和高分辨率结构。尺寸、量程、滞后和串扰随具体型号变化。
robotous.en: ROBOTOUS RFT capacitive six-axis sensors include compact, hollow-core, dust-sealed and high-resolution designs, with model-specific dimensions, ranges, hysteresis and crosstalk.

robotous.zh: 传感器与通信板、线缆共同组成测量链。部分型号集成电子，部分需要外部板卡；公开 ROS 驱动并不意味着所有接口可在所有硬件上同时使用。
robotous.en: Sensors, communication boards and cables form the measurement chain. Some models integrate electronics and others need external boards; public ROS drivers do not mean every interface is present on every model.

robotous.zh: 判断：公开接口利于集成，但型号级标定、温漂、噪声与过载保护仍决定测量质量。本轮厂商资料由分销商镜像托管，保留版本并不冒充实时新品目录。
robotous.en: Assessment: public interfaces aid integration, while calibration, drift, noise and overload protection determine quality. The manufacturer-authored sheet used here is distributor-hosted and versioned, not represented as a live new-product catalog.

sensodrive.zh: SENSODRIVE 把扭矩感测、驱动与控制集成在 SensoJoint 关节中，另提供 SensoTorque 定制扭矩传感器。关节包含电机、减速器、制动器、轴承和位置测量，不等同于只售电机的组件。
sensodrive.en: SENSODRIVE integrates torque sensing, drive and control in SensoJoint and also supplies custom SensoTorque transducers. A joint includes motor, gearbox, brake, bearing and position sensing, not just a motor.

sensodrive.zh: SensoJoint 分为 3000 至 7000 五个尺寸系列和不同减速比。额定与峰值扭矩、转速、制动力矩和外形需要按型号同时比较，安全功能还依赖上位安全控制的正确集成。
sensodrive.en: SensoJoint spans five sizes from 3000 to 7000 with multiple ratios. Rated/peak torque, speed, braking torque and geometry must be compared together; safety functions also depend on correct supervisory integration.

sensodrive.zh: 判断：机电一体化减少接口工作，但机械范围和控制软件约束可能增加平台绑定。功能安全器件不能自动使整台机器人达到同样的安全等级。
sensodrive.en: Assessment: integration reduces interface work but mechanical and software constraints may increase platform dependence. A safety-capable component does not automatically certify the complete robot.

leptrino.zh: LEPTRINO 提供六轴力传感器、测力台和切削力测量设备。CFS、FFS、PFS、BFS 系列在微型化、薄型结构、通用用途和刚性等方面区分，不宜只用最大量程作为选择依据。
leptrino.en: LEPTRINO supplies six-axis sensors, force plates and cutting-force instruments. CFS, FFS, PFS and BFS distinguish miniature, thin, general-purpose and structural designs; maximum range alone is insufficient for selection.

leptrino.zh: 除机器人末端力测量外，CFP/TFP 测力台用于力与压力中心测量，MFS/SFM 面向加工过程。软件的数据采集和分析功能与传感器机械规格分别保存。
leptrino.en: Beyond robot end-force measurement, CFP/TFP plates measure force and center of pressure, while MFS/SFM target machining. Software acquisition/analysis is distinct from mechanical sensor specifications.

leptrino.zh: 判断：公开逐型号性能和价格便于初筛，但网页价格不是实时采购承诺；新型号尚未公开的尺寸不应被当成零或沿用旧型号。
leptrino.en: Assessment: model-level specifications and prices aid initial screening, but web prices are not live procurement commitments. Unpublished new-model dimensions must not become zero or inherit older values.

wacoh-tech.zh: WACOH-TECH 的 DYN PICK 力觉产品以电容式感测为核心，提供多种六轴及三轴力传感器。不同封装与读出配置决定测量范围、重量和环境适用性。
wacoh-tech.en: WACOH-TECH DYN PICK capacitive products include six-axis and three-axis force sensors. Packaging and readout configurations determine range, mass and environmental suitability.

wacoh-tech.zh: 目录同时列出 USB、模拟、Ethernet、EtherCAT 转换器及专用线缆。传感器表中列出的多接口常包含选配适配器，不能据此认定裸传感器内置全部总线。
wacoh-tech.en: The catalog also lists USB, analog, Ethernet and EtherCAT adapters and dedicated cables. Multi-interface specification lists often depend on optional adapters rather than all buses being built into the sensor.

wacoh-tech.zh: 判断：转换器选择可适应不同控制系统，但需把采样、协议转换和控制周期分开核算。标称 IP 等级也不能替代装配后整条连接链的防护确认。
wacoh-tech.en: Assessment: adapters support different controllers, but acquisition, conversion and control-cycle timing must be budgeted separately. Sensor IP ratings do not establish protection of the assembled connection chain.

zivid.zh: Zivid AS 于 2015 年 5 月由 Henrik Schumann-Olsen 和 Øystein Skotheim 从 SINTEF 分拆成立，总部位于奥斯陆。公司时间线把 2001 至 2014 年列为前期三维和机器人视觉研发期，不应误写为公司成立时间。
zivid.en: Zivid AS was spun out of SINTEF in May 2015 by Henrik Schumann-Olsen and Oystein Skotheim and is headquartered in Oslo. Its timeline lists 2001-2014 as preceding 3D and robot-vision R&D, not the company's incorporation period.

zivid.zh: 本批次按官方选择器拆分 Zivid 2+ MR60、MR130、LR110 和 Zivid 3 XL250。对比页给出跨型号核心参数，但没有覆盖每份数据表的全部电气、连接、光学与合规字段，因此暂标官方部分覆盖。
zivid.en: This batch separates Zivid 2+ MR60, MR130, LR110, and Zivid 3 XL250 from the official selector. The comparison page supplies core cross-model figures but not every electrical, connectivity, optical, and compliance field in each datasheet, so records remain official-partial.

zivid.zh: 焦点处空间分辨率、点精度和真值度只对应页面给定距离与测量条件；不能直接外推到整个工作体积、透明/高反射表面或生产节拍。机器人安装还需要评估运动振动、线缆、遮挡和手眼标定稳定性。
zivid.en: Focus-plane spatial resolution, point precision, and trueness apply only at the stated distance and measurement conditions; they cannot be generalized across the whole volume, transparent or highly reflective surfaces, or production cycle time. Robot mounting also requires evaluation of motion vibration, cabling, occlusion, and hand-eye calibration stability.

photoneo.zh: Photoneo 提供工业三维视觉和机器人引导软件。PhoXi 与 Alpha 扫描器、MotionCam 三维相机分别面向不同的静态和运动采集需求，蓝光/红光及视场尺寸形成独立配置。
photoneo.en: Photoneo supplies industrial 3D vision and robot-guidance software. PhoXi/Alpha scanners and MotionCam cameras address different static and moving acquisition needs, with distinct color and field-size configurations.

photoneo.zh: 硬件之外还包括 Bin Picking Studio 和 Locator Studio 等定位、抓取应用软件。可见光颜色、工作距离、标定体积和物体运动条件共同影响采集表现。
photoneo.en: Software includes Bin Picking Studio and Locator Studio for localization and picking. Illumination, working distance, calibration volume and object motion jointly affect acquisition.

photoneo.zh: 判断：硬件与应用软件组合可缩短系统开发，但整站效果依赖照明、夹具、手眼标定和抓取规划。视觉设备额定帧率不等于机器人产线节拍。
photoneo.en: Assessment: combined hardware/software can reduce development time, but cell performance depends on lighting, fixtures, calibration and planning. Camera frame rate is not production cycle time.

ouster.zh: Ouster Technologies, Inc. 的运营前身成立于 2015 年 6 月 30 日。公司总部位于旧金山，Ouster, Inc. 为纳斯达克上市公司，代码 OUST。2025 年 Form 10-K 将目标市场归纳为汽车、工业、机器人和智慧基础设施。
ouster.en: Ouster Technologies, Inc., the operating predecessor, was founded on June 30, 2015. Headquartered in San Francisco, Ouster, Inc. is listed on Nasdaq as OUST. Its 2025 Form 10-K groups target markets into automotive, industrial, robotics, and smart infrastructure.

ouster.zh: 当前 Ouster 官网主导航列出 OSDome、OS0、OS1、OS1 Max 与 OS2，以及 Gemini、BlueCity 和 Ouster Studio。Rev8 v4.0 数据表按适用零件号公开了量程、分辨率、回波、数据输出、原生彩色、IMU、同步、功耗、尺寸、环境与合规信息；网页对比表与 PDF 个别数值不一致时，本仓库并列保存。
ouster.en: The current Ouster navigation lists OSDome, OS0, OS1, OS1 Max, and OS2 plus Gemini, BlueCity, and Ouster Studio. Rev8 v4.0 datasheets publish range, resolution, returns, data output, native color, IMU, synchronization, power, dimensions, environment, and compliance against applicable part numbers. Where the web comparison and PDFs differ, this repository keeps both figures.

ouster.zh: 公司于 2021 年收购 Sense Photonics，2023 年完成与 Velodyne Lidar 的合并，并在 2025 年停止制造 VLP-16、VLP-16 Lite、VLP-16 Hi-Res、VLP-32 与 VLS-128。2026 年 2 月收购 Stereolabs 后，Ouster 的企业级产品组合包含 ZED 相机与 AI Compute；为避免重复归属，本批次仍把 Stereolabs 具名型号留待独立公司目录同步。
ouster.en: The company acquired Sense Photonics in 2021, completed its merger with Velodyne Lidar in 2023, and stopped manufacturing VLP-16, VLP-16 Lite, VLP-16 Hi-Res, VLP-32, and VLS-128 in 2025. After the February 2026 Stereolabs acquisition, Ouster's corporate portfolio includes ZED cameras and AI Compute; to avoid duplicate ownership, named Stereolabs models remain for a separate company-catalog synchronization batch.

ouster.zh: 2025 年 Form 10-K 报告总收入 1.69384 亿美元、净亏损 6037.7 万美元。这是公司合并财务报表中的历史披露，不代表后续季度、单一产品盈利能力或未来表现。
ouster.en: The 2025 Form 10-K reports total revenue of USD 169.384 million and a net loss of USD 60.377 million. These are historical consolidated financial-statement figures, not evidence of later quarters, model-level profitability, or future performance.

realsense.zh: RealSense 技术最初在 Intel 内孵化。公司于 2025 年 7 月宣布从 Intel 独立，并完成 5,000 万美元 A 轮融资；总部位于库比蒂诺。这里将 2025 年记为独立公司的成立年份，而不是把技术品牌历史等同于现法律主体存续期。
realsense.en: RealSense technology was incubated within Intel. In July 2025 the company announced its spinout from Intel and a USD 50 million Series A; it is headquartered in Cupertino. This profile uses 2025 as the independent company's founding year rather than equating the technology brand's history with the current legal entity.

realsense.zh: 本批次按官方对比页拆分 D457、D456、D455、D455f、D435、D435i、D435f、D435if、D415 和 D405。对比页未覆盖全部电气、时序、光学和环境字段，因此这些记录标为官方部分覆盖，后续必须继续逐份转录数据表。
realsense.en: This batch separates D457, D456, D455, D455f, D435, D435i, D435f, D435if, D415, and D405 from the official comparison page. Because that page omits some electrical, timing, optical, and environmental fields, these records remain official-partial pending datasheet-by-datasheet transcription.

realsense.zh: 官网公布的装机比例、客户数量和市场覆盖属于公司口径，不等同于第三方审计市场份额。深度精度、最小距离和视场也受分辨率、标定、温度、纹理、照度与反射率影响。
realsense.en: Published installed-base, customer-count, and market-coverage figures are company statements, not independently audited market share. Depth accuracy, minimum distance, and field of view also depend on resolution, calibration, temperature, texture, illumination, and reflectivity.

orbbec.zh: 奥比中光成立于 2013 年，总部位于深圳。公司官网称其具备自研三维视觉芯片与系统技术，并在中国多地和美国设有业务或研发据点。官网公开的客户与覆盖国家数量属于公司口径，不能替代审计或第三方市场研究。
orbbec.en: Orbbec was established in 2013 and is headquartered in Shenzhen. The company states that it develops in-house 3D-vision chips and system technologies and maintains business or R&D locations in several Chinese cities and the United States. Published customer and country counts are company statements, not substitutes for audited or third-party market research.

orbbec.zh: 官网当前产品导航包含双目、ToF、结构光、相机计算平台、激光雷达和无机器人数据采集。本批次先对 Gemini 330 系列八个具名型号逐项拆分，其他产品保持在公司目录中，后续按各自数据表继续补足。
orbbec.en: The current product navigation covers stereo, ToF, structured light, camera computers, lidar, and robot-free data collection. This batch first separates the eight named Gemini 330 models; other products remain in the company catalog for later model-specific datasheet work.

orbbec.zh: 不同型号在基线、滤光、连接器、快门、防护、电源、同步和工作温度上差异明显。选型必须匹配具体型号，不能只以 Gemini 330 系列名称代替交付配置。
orbbec.en: Models differ materially in baseline, filtering, connector, shutter, ingress protection, power, synchronization, and temperature. Selection must identify the exact model rather than treating Gemini 330 as a deliverable configuration.

livox.zh: 览沃成立于 2016 年，总部位于深圳。公司官网将产品应用列为自动驾驶、机器人、三维测绘、智慧城市与安全等方向，并称产品已销往 26 个国家和地区；后者属于公司公开口径，不等同于经审计的市场份额。
livox.en: Livox was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Shenzhen. Its website lists autonomous driving, robotics, 3D mapping, smart cities, and security as application areas and states that products have been sold in 26 countries and regions; that is a company-published statement, not audited market-share evidence.

livox.zh: 本批次按当前可访问的具名规格页拆分 MID-360、MID-360S、Mid-70、Avia、Avia 2 与 Tele-15。不同页面采用不同的照度、反射率、距离和回波条件，因此数值只在各自条件下可比。
livox.en: This batch separates MID-360, MID-360S, Mid-70, Avia, Avia 2, and Tele-15 from currently accessible named specification pages. The pages use different illumination, reflectivity, distance, and return conditions, so figures are comparable only within their stated conditions.

livox.zh: 公司未在官网建立面向公众的定期财务报告库。本档案不据此推断收入、利润、估值、客户集中度或交付规模。
livox.en: The website does not expose a public periodic-financial-report library. This profile does not infer revenue, profit, valuation, customer concentration, or delivery volume from that absence.

leptrino: PFS / FFS multi-axis force sensor families

integration.zh: 通过以太网、官方 SDK 与产品支持的时间同步方式接入点云系统；供电、线缆、散热和同步拓扑必须按型号确认。
integration.en: Integrates into point-cloud systems through Ethernet, the official SDK, and model-supported time synchronization. Power, cabling, cooling, and timing topology must be confirmed per model.

verification.zh: 在目标反射率、日照、距离、雾雨、振动和运动条件下复测量程与精度，并核对低温启动功耗、外壳温度和 IP 边界。
verification.en: Retest range and precision under target reflectivity, sunlight, distance, fog/rain, vibration, and motion, and verify low-temperature startup power, enclosure temperature, and IP boundaries.

overview.zh: Avia 2 以 1535 nm 激光、普通 80° × 80° 视场与聚焦 15° × 15° 模式覆盖长距感知。
overview.en: Avia 2 combines a 1535 nm laser with an 80 x 80-degree normal field and a 15 x 15-degree focus mode for long-range perception.

overview.zh: 量程、等效反射率和精度来自厂商受控条件；普通与聚焦模式的视场、点率和最大距离不同，不应只比较单个 1000 m 数字。
overview.en: Range, equivalent-reflectivity, and precision figures come from manufacturer-controlled conditions. Normal and focus modes differ in field of view, point rate, and maximum range, so selection should not hinge on the 1000 m figure alone.

integration.zh: 通过以太网、官方 SDK 与产品支持的时间同步方式接入点云系统；供电、线缆、散热和同步拓扑必须按型号确认。
integration.en: Integrates into point-cloud systems through Ethernet, the official SDK, and model-supported time synchronization. Power, cabling, cooling, and timing topology must be confirmed per model.

verification.zh: 在目标反射率、日照、距离、雾雨、振动和运动条件下复测量程与精度，并核对低温启动功耗、外壳温度和 IP 边界。
verification.en: Retest range and precision under target reflectivity, sunlight, distance, fog/rain, vibration, and motion, and verify low-temperature startup power, enclosure temperature, and IP boundaries.

overview.zh: MID-360 以水平 360°、垂直 -7° 至 52° 视场和 0.1 m 近处盲区面向小型移动机器人近距感知。
overview.en: MID-360 targets near-field perception on compact mobile robots with a 360-degree horizontal and -7 to 52-degree vertical field of view and a 0.1 m blind zone.

overview.zh: 页面列出的量程和误差均带反射率、照度、距离或温度条件；低反射率细小物体、水面和亮面近距检测不能只按标称盲区判断。
overview.en: Published range and error figures carry reflectivity, illumination, distance, or temperature conditions; near-field detection of low-reflectivity small objects, water, and polished surfaces cannot be judged from the nominal blind zone alone.
